topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Well, now. I got a letter this morning. Seems an old buddy from way back, we used to run the streets together like we owned 'em, claims he doesn't recall me. Not buying it for a second. But you know what? It got me thinking about those days, the mischief, the laughs, the secret forts that were just old boxes in empty lots. I figured, maybe it's not about me, or him, or even those lost memories. Maybe it's about the stories that make us who we are, the ones we carry whether we remember every detail or not. So, I reckon I'll write him back, share a yarn or two, no hard feelings. Might just jog that memory, or better yet, we'll build some new ones.
